topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the main learning outcomes and connecting cellular transformation to histopathology.

topics.label: Viral discovery of oncogenes and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic and tumor-suppressive mutations affect cell cycle checkpoints and cellular phenotypes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and forms of genomic instability in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the distinct causes and cellular consequences of sequence instability and chromosomal instability arising from repair and mitotic defects.

topics.label: Multistep tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inherited and acquired mutations drive the stepwise progression and evolution of malignant tumors.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecture closing with recommended reading and an outlook on upcoming topics.
